messages.body:

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Feb 11, 2020, Abhilash J wrote:
>'/home/abhilash/AMBER/amber18/AmberTools/src/cifparse'
>[CIFPARSE] BISON cifparse.y
>"cifparse.y", line 1: unknown character `-' in declaration section
>"cifparse.y", line 1: no input grammar
>"cifparse.y", line 1: unknown character with code 0x0 in declaration section
First: what is the result of typing "bison --version"?
Second: what is the result of typing "head
$AMBERHOME/AmberTools/src/cifparse/cifparse.y" ?
What operating system are you using?
(The two possibilities I'm thinking of now are either a corrupted file,
or an old version of bison.)
...thanks....dac
